name: Smartbird, Inc.
description: Smartbird, Inc. operates in the artificial intelligence infrastructure market in the United States. The company acquires and monetizes graphics processing units (GPUs), related high-performance computing infrastructure capable of supporting high workloads, and other related assets. Smartbird was formerly known as Allbirds, Inc., a direct-to-consumer footwear and apparel brand, and changed its name to Smartbird, Inc. in 2026 following the sale of its historical footwear business; the go-forward AI infrastructure business is early stage and has no established operating history. The company's Class A common stock carries one vote per share and trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol BIRD; its Class B common stock carries ten votes per share and is not listed. The company effected a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of its common stock on September 4, 2024. Smartbird, Inc. was incorporated in Delaware in 2015 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.
